description: Exploratory comparisons of intermediate builds; six counterbalanced triplets at width256, three routes. Intermediate worktrees were dirty; executable and source hashes identify each measurement. The final clean-revision comparison is the primary result.

record.comparison: prebuilt baseline vs optimized Imre vs unchanged CPython

tools.clang:
Ubuntu clang version 18.1.3 (1ubuntu1)
Target: x86_64-pc-linux-gnu
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /usr/lib/llvm-18/bin

method.timer: time.perf_counter_ns around subprocess.run; shared with benchmark.py
method.includes: fresh process startup, stdin/stdout pipes, complete route-planner execution, and process exit
method.excludes: all native compilation, correctness validation, and warmups
method.ordering: all six orders in a repeating cycle; adjacent orders reverse each other
method.cpu: harness and all child processes inherit the same single-CPU affinity
method.native_provenance: optional build records verify source and executable hashes; toolchains are not inferred from prebuilt binaries
method.spread: minimum, maximum and quartiles describe observed samples, not confidence intervals
